Summary: Zoom crashes frequently after a recent update, and the most recent crash occurred right after the update was installed.
likely_cause: A recent update to Zoom Workplace 6.4.1 may be causing instability.
Evidence: On Sat 7:29:52 AM, Zoom crashed unexpectedly, directly after installation of Zoom Workplace 6.4.1 on Thu 11:09:52 PM.
Three crashes occurred in the last 72 hours, all linked to Zoom closing unexpectedly.
No resource usage data available to show high CPU or memory use during crashes.
Only one change recorded: installation of Zoom Workplace 6.4.1, which coincides with crash timeline.
Steps: Uninstall Zoom Workplace 6.4.1 from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Reinstall Zoom from the official Zoom website to ensure a stable version.
Check for updates in Zoom after installation to ensure you have the latest stable version.
